title: Coprimality Census
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n. Line 2: n values. Print the number of pairs
i < j with gcd(a[i], a[j]) == 1.

**Constraints:** 1 <= n <= 100000; 1 <= a[i] <= 1e6.

**R versus W.** The graded wrong solution counts every pair sharing
any common divisor >= 2.

tests.name: pairwise non-coprime, gcd 1 overall
tests.hint: Every pair shares exactly one prime (2, 3, 5): Mobius cancels to 0; the naive divisor count says 3.

tests.name: all coprime primes
load: 100000 values up to 1e6
tests.hint: Mobius sieve over the value range; harmonic divisor sums stay linear.
